items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: Was it any different going from Sidney Desdine to Don?

ctx.x: Claiborne Williams. Claiborne Williams. That's the one I'm trying to think of. Yeah. Well, anyway, so they were smaller than Don's band and... Oh, yes. Oh, yes. And was it any different going from Sidney Desdine to Don? Was it about the same kind of band?
Yes, about the same type of band. Reading band with the three, three reads and you know, the full band. Full band. Full band.
